metadata.method_name: Blind held-out confirmation panel for a cheap per-checkpoint safety readout
metadata.artifact_role: PRODUCER-ONLY, BLIND SUBSTRATE. Grades behaviour, saves arrays, commits a hash-chained manifest. Computes NO candidate score.

hardware.note: The artifact plan assumed a 23,034 MiB L4; see deviation D02. The declared 7.5 GB VRAM budget was kept and enforced.

provenance.rule: rows with set=='harm' (45 sr_* Lane C harmful + 40 xsNNN_u XSTest-twin harmful)
safety_2x2 table, rows with metadata_request_level=='benign_twin', unique by metadata_pair_uid, text taken from metadata_plain_prompt; coherence_control table NEVER used
safety_2x2 table, rows with metadata_request_level=='harmful', unique by metadata_pair_uid, text taken from metadata_plain_prompt; coherence_control table NEVER used
rows with set=='benign' and item_id startswith 'orh_' -- kept EXACTLY as shipped, no top-up, no trim
provenance.note: 43 not 40; see deviations[] and notes[] for the reconciliation against H1/results/graded_truth.json

metadata.THIS_FILE_REPORTS_NO_WINNER: By design. No W1-W8, G1-G4 or A1-A3 quantity, no Spearman/Pearson statistic, no partial correlation, no McNemar test, no ranking, no 'best band', no survivor file is computed anywhere in this artifact. A sibling screen artifact freezes its candidate list BEFORE opening anything here; a third re-runs the join. The absence of scores is the design, not a failed run. A blindness lint (src/hygiene_check.py) enforces this over every file under results/ and arrays/ and its report is in metadata.blindness_lint.
metadata.demo_note: Curated demo subset of full_method_out.json. The graded_behaviour rows are subsampled to 5 checkpoints x 5 rows per item set; panel_manifest__per_checkpoint (all 29, metadata_array_paths stripped) and inhouse_noop_effective_set (all 11) are COMPLETE, so the cross-checkpoint instrument diagnostics reproduce exactly.
